name: Theme to scene generator
description: Layout slots with H/V rules and safe zones. SB3 (D341): services/scene-builder/build.mjs turns a reference read (SB2) into a scene package: the reference canvas takes the slot boxes, the other canvas follows data/scene-builder/build-rules.json (V inside the safe zone of data/clip/targets.json, game never cropped; H left column beside the game). Sources link to the project by reference; low-confidence or unmatched slots become listed placeholders; graphics are token panels (ujwalam-panel overlay).
